name: enterprise-patterns
description: Martin Fowler's enterprise application patterns as a Claude Code toolkit: choose business logic, persistence, transaction, locking, presentation and remoting patterns by force, keep responsibilities separate, and review for the book's forbidden patterns. Unofficial.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
